_intent: Machine-readable single source of truth for sample lesson Topic 1.1 — How This Course Works (synthetic sample content). Designed from the sample outline rows T1.1.r1-T1.1.r3. Durations are integer frames @30fps and start is cumulative; they are design estimates — narration length is authoritative at build. outlineRow and narration.targetWords carry the plan's fidelity + word-budget columns.

title: How this
course works.
copy.sub: Short lessons, one skill each, practiced in a real assistant.

narration.gist: Welcome to Topic 1. Before we touch a tool, here's how the next five lessons work and what you'll do in each one.

copy.quote: One skill per lesson. You see it in a real assistant, then you try it on your own work.

narration.gist: Lessons are short on purpose: one skill each. Every skill is shown in a real assistant first, then you use it on something from your own week. Watching alone won't build the skill; the practice step does.

copy.title: You're right here
copy.sub: Five short lessons. Each one adds a skill the next one uses.

narration.gist: Here's the whole topic. You're at the start. Next you'll pick an assistant for a task, write a clear prompt, check what comes back, and make the assistant yours. Automating work comes later, in Topic 3.

copy.title: Three steps, every time
cards: 01 · See the idea — one short concept, one clear example
02 · Watch it in a tool — the skill shown step by step in an assistant
03 · Try it on your own task — the practice step that makes it stick

narration.gist: Every lesson in this topic runs the same three steps: see the idea, watch it in a tool, try it on your own task. Same rhythm every time, so you always know what's coming.

copy.title: Get ready to practice
copy.sub: Four quick things. Tick them off as you go.

items.name: Open an assistant you can already use
items.why: Any assistant from the course tool list works for Topic 1.

items.name: Start a fresh chat for practice
items.why: Keeps course practice separate from your other conversations.

items.name: Start a one-line practice log
items.why: Note what you tried and what came back, every lesson.

items.name: Pick one real task from your week
items.why: You'll reuse it in every Topic 1 lesson.

narration.gist: Walk through the four setup items as they tick off. On the last one, pause: pick one real task from your week, something you'd happily hand off, and write it in your log. Hold onto it.

motion.beat: glide to item 1 checkbox, click, check pops, row tints accentSoft, why-line fades up
glide to item 4 and park beside the open checkbox (engagement pause)

scenes.interactionNotes: The one interactive scene: animate the ticking, not a finished list. cursor → item 1 → click → check → item 2 → … → park on item 4 for the 'pick a real task' pause → tick. SceneAmbient keeps drifting through the pause.

narration.gist: Hold onto that task. In the next lesson we'll pick the right assistant for it.
